name: wow-trader
description: Build-aware World of Warcraft economy intelligence platform

scripts.desktop:make:macos:x64: pnpm --filter @wow-trader/desktop build:utility && pnpm --filter @wow-trader/desktop exec electron-forge make --platform=darwin --arch=x64 --targets=@electron-forge/maker-dmg
scripts.desktop:make:macos:arm64: pnpm --filter @wow-trader/desktop build:utility && pnpm --filter @wow-trader/desktop exec electron-forge make --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --targets=@electron-forge/maker-dmg
scripts.desktop:make:windows: pnpm --filter @wow-trader/desktop build:utility && pnpm --filter @wow-trader/desktop exec electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --targets=@electron-forge/maker-zip
scripts.desktop:make:linux: pnpm --filter @wow-trader/desktop build:utility && pnpm --filter @wow-trader/desktop exec electron-forge make --platform=linux --arch=x64 --targets=@electron-forge/maker-zip
scripts.desktop:release: pnpm desktop:make:macos && pnpm desktop:make:windows && pnpm desktop:make:linux && node scripts/prepare-companion-release.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.leveling:addon:campaign: pnpm --filter @wow-trader/leveling build && pnpm --filter @wow-trader/reference-data build && node scripts/build-leveling-campaign-addon.mjs
scripts.leveling:restedxp:test: pnpm --filter @wow-trader/leveling build && pnpm --filter @wow-trader/reference-data build && node --test scripts/export-restedxp-import.test.mjs scripts/campaign-addon-review-check.test.mjs
